mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM organization_access.tenant_lifecycle WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT authorization_revision FROM organization_access.tenant_feature_settings WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.member_conversation_features (tenant_id, membership_id, assistant_selection, conversation, own_history, authorized_citations, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, #{features.assistantSelection}, #{features.conversation}, #{features.ownHistory}, #{features.authorizedCitations}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_access.tenant_feature_settings SET authorization_revision = authorization_revision + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND authorization_revision = #{expected}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.member_account_operation (tenant_id, actor_subject_id, operation_key, operation, membership_id, command_fingerprint, result_identity_version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{actor}, #{key}, #{operation}, #{membershipId}, #{fingerprint}, #{identityVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT membership_id FROM organization_access.tenant_membership WHERE member_access_pending_revocation ORDER BY membership_id
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_access.tenant_membership SET member_access_pending_revocation = FALSE WHERE membership_id = #{membershipId} AND member_access_pending_revocation
